metadata.problem_statement: This is a local Docker smoke test for the coding-agent RL loop. No source change is required. Inspect the repository briefly, run `PYTHONPATH=/workspace/slime python -m pytest -q tests/test_agent/test_trajectory_manager_branching.py`, and finish with a one-line summary.
